description: Input schema for ElevenLabs Voice Remix.

voice_id.description: Voice ID to remix (from voice-clone, voice-design, or a premade voice ID).
voice_id.title: Voice Id

description.description: Describe how to modify the voice (e.g. 'Make it sound younger with an American accent and faster pacing').
description.title: Description

preview_text.description: Text to speak in the previews. If not provided, text is auto-generated.
preview_text.title: Preview Text

prompt_strength.description: How much to apply the remix description (0-1). Lower preserves more of the original voice.
prompt_strength.title: Prompt Strength

title: AppInput
